obligations.detail: Native Qtbase/SVG/PDF and all retained plugins are correlated to official SDK sections, build SBOMs, source commits and source-file hashes. Remaining: exact PySide6/shiboken6 6.12.0 and PySide6_Pdf 6.12.0.140 binding build configuration, patches/source revisions and compiled binding notices. Catalogs are excluded.

Mesa executable/data sections match three official Qt variants; software-context probe actually loads the DLL. Retained nominal Mesa 11.2.2/LLVM 3.6.2 sources, MIT/Boost/NCSA notices and Qt attribution. Remaining: confirm compiled LLVM/auxiliary notice closure and any distribution-specific attribution; exact recipe is useful provenance, not a newly invented GPL source obligation for these permissive components.

Official Qt for Python community documentation and correlated SDK target licenses establish open-source LGPL/GPL alternatives. A commercial-reference file does not make the public wheels commercial-only. Binding wheels still omit separate open-source copyright/third-party notice manifests; request those and assess retained source notices for the exact binding build.

All 20 retained Qt libraries/plugins match every official SDK section. Official Qtbase/SVG/PDF SBOMs, configured Chromium-PDF notice SBOM and full source-file correlation retained. Their complete notice texts and copyrights accompany the installer. SDK build-only and unshipped targets remain distinguished; PySide binding evidence is a separate blocker.

Owner must establish rights under exact applicable Visual Studio / Windows SDK licenses, including SDK open-source distribution restrictions. Official documentation, conda SDK/runtime license terms and exact DLL origins are retained. If unresolved, use official user-installed VC x64 runtime and Windows UCRT, remove app-local copies only in a separately rebuilt/tested candidate.

Frozen shipped-extension probes and import tables identify JPEG-turbo 3.1.4.1, OpenJPEG 2.5.4, TIFF 4.7.1, zlib-ng 2.3.3, lcms 2.19, WebP 1.6.0, libavif 1.4.2, dav1d 1.5.3 and AOM 3.14.1. Added missing AOM license/patent text, full dav1d notice and recipe-selected libyuv notices. Windows recipe enables libyuv/libsharpyuv and TIFF/lzma; confirm exact secondary static closure and whether any additional notice is required. _imagingft is physically absent; unused _imagingtk remains physically shipped despite lacking tkinter.

Exact binary release and pinned builder match; release args.gn and 14 build-graph-derived notices retained, every notice installed identically. Windows x64 job succeeded at builder f2e9a1c45bb17b85b540abf1af30146ef65416ac. Current branch commit 8ca5b735df4263f43c830479b78213854a392c22 predates the build but is only an inference; public job logs return 403 and version.json source hash is null. Ask only for exact checkout and unhandled notice warnings, or review sufficiency of existing permissive binary/notice evidence; exact source delivery is not asserted mandatory under BSD.

Compatible separate DLL/plugin layout, no runtime hash/signature restriction, original four modified-header loads/restoration retained. No MSVC C++ component or CMake is installed (vswhere -requires VC.Tools.x86.x64 returns []). Independently rebuilt modified code therefore remains untested; no compiler/SDK installation was performed. Assess LGPLv3 section 4 replacement/debugging terms and applicable installation information. Installer upgrades replace modifications; backups are necessary.

Separate Phase 6.3 application and dependency-source/evidence assets preserve full original sources plus SDK source/build SBOMs and new attribution evidence. Native Qt source correlation is established; binding configuration and Mesa notice closure remain open. Review GPLv2 3(a), GPLv3 6(d), LGPLv3 4, free adjacent source downloads, retention/backup and any User Product installation information. Nothing published; no written offer relied on.
Confirm ownership/authority for NutCase code, documentation and assets. Supplied STEP models remain excluded from installer and application source pending ownership review.
Actual payload and frozen module inventories contain no FreeCAD/OCCT binaries; FreeCAD remains a separately installed prerequisite.

Full recovered development-host suites and disposable installation checks are recorded in PHASE6_3_REVIEW.md. Clean Windows 10/11, RDP/VM graphics, interactive acceptance, real version upgrade and explicit publication approval remain pending. No release or external correspondence created.
